Branch constraints (from the two current sources):  
(1) Between mesh 1–2 (Is = 4 mA up):

(2) Between mesh 2–3 (2·i1 down):  
 i2 + i3 = 2·i1  

Supermesh KVL around all three loops (excluding the two current‐source branches):  
 4000·i1 + 8000·i2 – 2000·i3 + 40 V – 100 V = 0  
→ 4000 i1 + 8000 i2 – 2000 i3 = 60  

Solve stepwise:  
From (1) i2 = i1 + 0.004  
From (2) i3 = 2 i1 – i2 = i1 – 0.004  

Plug into KVL:  
 4000 i1 + 8000·(i1+0.004) – 2000·(i1–0.004) = 60  
 (4000+8000–2000) i1 + (8000·0.004 + 2000·0.004) = 60  
 10000 i1 + 40 = 60  
 i1 = 0.002 A  
⇒ i2 = 0.002 + 0.004 = 0.006 A  
⇒ i3 = 0.002 – 0.004 = –0.002 A  

**Node Voltages (from mesh currents)**  
vx is the node between R1 (to 100 V) and R2:
